content: {"praised":["Hayley Mills delivers outstanding, award‑winning performance.","Film offers depth and complexity beyond typical family fare.","Timeless optimism and faith resonate throughout the story.","First Disney film for Hayley Mills, iconic debut.","Engaging, wholesome family entertainment with strong themes."],"criticized":["Story diverges significantly from original book.","Characters altered, losing original personalities.","Tone too negative, not suitable for children.","Fails to capture Pollyanna’s genuine optimism.","Depicts town and characters as ruthless, contrary to book."]}
